study.title: Is Generative AI Displacing Arabic? Perceived Change in Arabic Use Among Lebanese Arabic-English Bilinguals
study.author: Hadi Ghazi

items.q: When did you start using AI tools regularly (at least weekly)?
How often do you use AI tools?
How much of your work or study do you do with the help of AI?
In which language do you usually write to AI?
What do you use AI for? (tick all that apply)
How often do you come across AI-generated content (videos, voice-overs, summaries in search results)?
When the same content is available in AI-generated Arabic voice and in the original English, which do you usually choose?
Before using AI, did you write in Fusha (assignments, exams, official letters)?
Since you started using AI regularly, did any of these also happen? (tick all that apply)

question.ar: بسبب الذكاء الاصطناعي، هل أصبحت تقوم بكلٍّ مما يلي أقل أم أكثر؟

social_media_q.en: Over the same period, because of social media, do you now use Arabic less or more?
social_media_q.ar: خلال الفترة نفسها، بسبب وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، هل أصبحت تستخدم العربية أقل أم أكثر؟

substitution_q.en: Has it happened that you did something in English, although you could have done it in Arabic, because AI helps you better in English?
substitution_q.ar: هل حدث أن أنجزت عملاً بالإنجليزية، مع أنه كان بإمكانك إنجازه بالعربية، لأن الذكاء الاصطناعي يساعدك أفضل بالإنجليزية؟
